resolution.question: Will at least one of the forty procurement leads that Brightline Software's rep Gustavo cold-emails this week agree to a discovery call before the end of the month?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least one of the forty procurement leads actually sent a reply agreeing to a discovery call before 2026-08-31T17:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
